title: TANDEM: Temporal-Aware Neural Detection for Multimodal Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to identify specific racial groups (e.g., Blacks, Whites) targeted by multimodal hate speech using average F1 and Exact Match metrics.
Evaluating the model's ability to identify specific religious groups (e.g., Jews, Muslims, Christians) targeted by multimodal hate speech using average F1 and Exact Match metrics.
Evaluating the model's ability to identify specific gender identities (e.g., Woman, Man) targeted by multimodal hate speech using average F1 and Exact Match metrics.
Evaluating the model's ability to identify sexual orientation groups (e.g., LGBTQ) targeted by multimodal hate speech using average F1 and Exact Match metrics.
